# Deephaven requests in protobuf's bytes, as protobuf's own (Python) library writes them over the message
# definitions pydeephaven 42.7 ships: json_format.Parse of each PLAN as a BatchTableRequest, its last operation's
# result id set to the export e/7. Each PLAN is the batch L2's target wrote for its QUERY in the parity run
# (docs/DEEPHAVEN_PLAN_2026_10_22.md §9); DeephavenWireTest encodes the PLAN with lite's encoder and compares the
# bytes (DH11). Kept as written: a change to the target does not change these.

QUERY #>{risk::Ref.trades}#->filter(x|$x.region == 'EMEA')->select(~[year])->distinct()->sort([~year->descending()])->limit(501)
PLAN {"ops": [{"view": {"sourceId": {"ticket": {"ticket": "cy90cmFkZXM="}}, "columnSpecs": ["t0__id = id", "t0__region = region", "t0__country = country", "t0__desk = desk", "t0__year = year", "t0__qty = qty", "t0__notional = notional", "t0__pnl = pnl", "t0__instrument = instrument"]}}, {"unstructuredFilter": {"sourceId": {"batchOffset": 0}, "filters": ["(!isNull(t0__region) && t0__region == `EMEA`)"]}}, {"view": {"sourceId": {"batchOffset": 1}, "columnSpecs": ["year = t0__year"]}}, {"selectDistinct": {"sourceId": {"batchOffset": 2}, "columnNames": ["year"]}}, {"updateView": {"sourceId": {"batchOffset": 3}, "columnSpecs": ["__n0 = isNull(year)"]}}, {"sort": {"sourceId": {"batchOffset": 4}, "sorts": [{"columnName": "__n0", "direction": "DESCENDING"}, {"columnName": "year", "direction": "DESCENDING"}]}}, {"head": {"sourceId": {"batchOffset": 5}, "numRows": "501"}}, {"dropColumns": {"sourceId": {"batchOffset": 6}, "columnNames": ["__n0"]}}]}
